rejected_designs.reason: The proxy requires certificate authority and explicit guest proxy configuration that are outside the workstation authority and would intercept the full developer session.
Public package and installer hosts use shared CDN ranges, so a CIDR firewall allow would grant materially broader and mutable internet access.
Adding a whole-internet allow above the priority-65000 default deny removes the control this contract exists to preserve.

components.summary: Build Nix, Git, tmux, guest support, contract verification, and idle shutdown into an immutable x86_64-linux NixOS GCE image.
Publish only a content-addressed raw-disk archive and retain its generation, source digest, contract digest, and clean source commit.
Create the CMEK-protected Compute Image from an exact HTTPS object and generation; GitHub cannot create or select the image.
Consume only an exact image self-link and embedded contract digest, with no public runtime package or installer fetch.

selected_design.summary: Everything required for first boot is baked into an immutable image, so the existing restricted API and metadata destinations are sufficient and no public egress destination is added.
